label: Enclosure
subgoals: Subtract via edges from the corresponding metal edges
Take the minimum of the four margins
Compare it with the required enclosure

label: Two-sided enclosure rules
subgoals: Take the minimum of each opposite pair of margins
Test the pairs against b and a in one orientation
Test the other orientation and pass if either holds

label: Extension and endcaps
subgoals: Compute each end's extension as poly end minus diffusion edge
Take the shortfall max(0, E - extension) per end
Sum the shortfalls over all gates
